requirement: The semantic judge must not share the critic's model. Either a human reviewer judges every semantic item, or a judge from a different provider does, with its identity recorded.

options.judge: a human reviewer who did not author the sealed expectations
options.independence_basis: a different kind of judge; correlated errors with the critic are still possible and are not ruled out by this choice alone

options.judge: a model from a provider other than the critic's
options.independence_basis: different provider and model; shared training data or prompt effects remain possible

currently_available.consequence: Neither option is available now, so release-v1 cannot execute until one is arranged; running with a same-model judge would leave every semantic item not_judged under this design.

not_claimed: a universal independence threshold or score
that any listed option makes errors statistically independent
